title: Tropical Plant Systematics 2027
about: The Organization for Tropical Studies' Tropical Plant Systematics 2027 course runs 20 June to 27 July 2027 at the three OTS research stations in Costa Rica, with a visit to herbaria in San José. For graduate students and young professionals. Deadline: March 20, 2027.
requirements: At least a bachelor's degree in biology, ecology, agronomy or related fields
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for 'Tropical Plant Systematics 2027' by the Organization for Tropical Studies (OTS), Costa Rica; deadline 20 Mar 2027. The background is a generic default photo of a city skyline over a river at sunset and does not show Costa Rica.
